facts.fact: Internet Society Pulse, from PeeringDB, lists CAMIX Douala in Cameroon with 10 member ASNs and 40 Gbps cumulative port capacity, 9 of 10 peering at the route server (data as of August 2026).
Akamai Technologies (AS20940, content network) is listed as a member of CAMIX Douala with a 4 Gbps port, peering at the route server, per PeeringDB via Internet Society Pulse.
Of CAMIX Douala's 10 members, 3 are registered abroad: PCH AS3856 and PCH AS42 (United States) and Akamai Technologies (Netherlands), per PeeringDB via Internet Society Pulse.
